author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: SQUARE: slim pen on a 1:3 axis (sides 9.5 apart, symmetric r5 cap touching the right edge, collar line above a pointed nib) beside the reference scribble traced as smooth cubics through integer knots (top sweep into a left loop, a hump, then a long stroke down to the bottom), kept 8+ from the pen.
omissions: Pen drawn wider than the reference's hairline pen (outline needs 8+ between sides); scribble's final rightward flick shortened to a downward end.
